tavily.text:
To install pyRevit, download the installer from the releases page on GitHub. The latest installers available are pyRevit 6.5.5.26237 for Admin/All Users/%PROGRAMDATA% and pyRevit CLI 6.5.5.26237 for Admin/System %PATH%. For installation issues, users have suggested commands like "pyrevit clones add master" and "pyrevit attach master 277 --installed" in the command prompt. However, if these commands do not resolve installation issues, further assistance may be required. To install pyRevit, download the installer from the GitHub releases page. The latest versions available are pyRevit 6.5.5.26237 Installer - Admin / All Users / %PROGRAMDATA% and pyRevit CLI 6.5.5.26237 Installer - Admin / System %PATH%. For per-user installations, use pyRevit 6.5.2.26175 Installer — Per-user / %LOCALAPPDATA%. The installation process can be guided by the pyRevit environment command `pyrevit env` if issues arise. To install pyRevit, you can use pip to install the pyrevit-stubs-24 package. The installation command is `pip install pyrevit-stubs-26`. After installation, give your IDE some time to index all new files for autocomplete suggestions. Note that only one version of pyrevit-stubs should be installed at a time, and the code will be executed by pyRevit's engine, not your IDE. The package provides unofficial type stubs for Autodesk Revit API and pyRevit modules, and is independently created and not affiliated with or endorsed by Autodesk.
